models.name: Muse Spark Open

engines.hardware: 2x M5 Ultra Mac Studio, 512GB unified memory each (1TB total), Thunderbolt 5 + RDMA
engines.quant: Meta's documented Mac recipe for the compressed Muse Spark Open weights; each machine needs storage for a complete copy of the model

models.why: Meta's own Mac guide for Muse Spark Open needs two 512GB M5 Ultra Mac Studios linked over Thunderbolt 5 with RDMA (or four 256GB machines) and generates about 25 tok/s generation — the open 816B model runs locally, but only as a cluster on a desk.
